text:
alex: Heads-up — the buyer returned a completed SIG/CAIQ and flagged a few high-risk rows around KMS, tenant isolation, and access to cached tokens. They want an exception for our hosted KMS model.

maria: can you drop the doc link? :eyes:

alex: https://files.acme.example.com/sig_acme_v1.2.pdf — TL;DR: they require CMEK + HSM + dedicated tenancy for sensitive data. POC currently on Hosted.

dan: Sales wants a quick yes/no. Is Dedicated available for this account during POC?

maria: POC can be moved to Dedicated pool; needs infra lead to provision. We should avoid promising without security approval.

alex: Proposed compensating controls we can offer for a timebound exception: 
- Dedicated capacity for the customer's workloads
- Customer-managed KMS (CMEK) with HSM-backed keys (where supported)
- VPC peering or private link + strict SGs to limit egress
- Real-time audit log export to customer's SIEM + weekly attestation
- 6-month review and automatic revocation of exception if controls lapse

maria: tagging @raj for security review and @sarah for legal wording.

raj: Reviewing now. Quick clarifying q: do we currently support CMEK on Hosted? My understanding: Hosted (multi-tenant) does not; Dedicated or Private can integrate with customer KMS. Need to confirm if the customer's KMS can be attached to Dedicated in their cloud region.

sarah: Legal needs the exact contractual language for key custody + a timebound exception clause. Also need to record acceptance in vendor risk system.

raj: I can approve an exception conditionally if the customer accepts these controls and we capture them in a signed amendment: CMEK enabled, Dedicated capacity, VPC peering, audit forwarding, and a 6-month re-eval. Also require SOC2 boundary statements and attestation of key rotation policy.

dan: Noted — finance/sales impact: Dedicated + CMEK provisioning will increase monthly cost. I'll log delta in the quote.

sec-bot: Created RFC 5872: "acme-kms-exception" — https://infra.redwood/rfcs/5872 (auto-linking for tracking).

maria: I'll draft the risk acceptance doc and the suggested amendment. Who signs the acceptance?

raj: Security will sign after controls are validated. Legal (@sarah) must sign the amendment. Sales (@dan) to confirm commercial terms.

sarah: Agreed. I'll prepare the contract language and add clause: "Timebound security exception — 180 days, conditions listed in Appendix X; subject to audit logs and attestation."

alex: POC team can move to Dedicated by next week if infra schedules it (target: 03/21).

raj: Action items for me: update SIG matrix rows 2.3/4 with the compensating controls and add the acceptance memo to vendor-risk.

maria: Action items: draft amendment, email customer proposed controls/timeline, confirm cost delta with @dan.

dan: I'll update the SOW draft with estimated Dedicated + KMS fees and call out the security amendment line item.

alex: Thanks team. I'll notify customer that we're prepared to proceed pending signed amendment and infra provisioning.

maria: Sent initial email to buyer with proposed controls and timeline. cc: @raj @sarah.

raj: Final note — approving the exception in principle. Conditions must be met before we enable CMEK. I'll mark this as "security-approved (conditional)" in vendor-risk.

sarah: Legal signs off on timebound exception wording.

dan: Sales acknowledges and will incorporate costs into the quote.

alex: Closing thread once amendment signed. :white_check_mark:
